relationships.subject: ACC fast-spiking interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Bath application of non-competitive AMPA receptor antagonist GYKI 53655 followed by CNQX revealed that both FS-INs and RS-INs have AMPA and KA mediated components.

relationships.subject: ACC regular-spiking interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Bath application of non-competitive AMPA receptor antagonist GYKI 53655 followed by CNQX revealed that both FS-INs and RS-INs have AMPA and KA mediated components.

key_findings: Combined whole-cell patch and MED64 mapping showed single ACC pyramidal neurons and interneurons receive heterogeneous excitatory inputs from multiple ACC subregions and layers.
Both FS and RS interneurons in ACC have AMPA and kainate receptor-mediated EPSC components; EPSC kinetics differ between pyramidal, FS and RS cells.
